speaker: (the gatherer)
text: The Queen is come up to Whitehall, sirs. Of a sudden, from Richmond. The watermen have it at every stair.

speaker: (the gatherer)
text: Nobody can say why. Only that she is come.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Christmas is set down for Richmond. A court does not move in December for nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the reason will be at Whitehall by supper and in Aldermanbury by breakfast. It will not be here at two.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Wherever she sleeps tonight, the yard is half full and the Shrew begins at two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in it. I will hear the first act from the door and be home before the candle.

speaker: john_heminges
text: If you have the why before I do, send to Aldermanbury.
